claims.statement: From 18 February 2027, the EU Batteries Regulation requires an electronic battery passport for each LMT battery, EV battery, and industrial battery above 2 kWh placed on the market or put into service.

The regulation requires differentiated access, model- and battery-specific information, interoperability, and records including composition, parts, dismantling, and test evidence, implying a multi-party data-governance problem.

Hypothesis: small assemblers and importers will prefer a shared supplier-onboarding rail over collecting the same evidence independently for every model, provided permissions and confidentiality are credible.

contrary_evidence: Passport data must use interoperable open structures without vendor lock-in, limiting defensibility based purely on hosting or format.
Large manufacturers, ERP vendors, and industry consortia may implement supplier exchange internally before SMEs buy a standalone network.

economics.acquisition_route: Referral agreements with test labs and compliance consultants, supplier-facing free portals, and targeted technical guidance
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 120 operators averaging 45,000 PLN ARR plus onboarding can exceed 5m PLN revenue; majority ownership of a profitable compliance network could yield over 5m PLN founder equity in four to seven years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly through the first three design partners, falling toward 10 hours with delegated compliance support
economics.gross_margin_basis: Target 70-85% software gross margin after onboarding templates; legal, testing, and assurance work is partner-delivered or separately billed
economics.payback: Customer payback comes from fewer supplier chases, avoided launch delay, and reusable evidence across multiple SKUs; target vendor CAC payback under 12 months
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 10,000-35,000 PLN onboarding per operator, 1,500-6,000 PLN monthly, and low per-passport usage charges
economics.retention_or_repeat: Passports and supplier evidence need updates across long product lives, while every new model adds usage

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A permissioned evidence graph reusing verified supplier and component records across many models and customers
fingerprint.customer: Central European battery pack assemblers, importers, and second-life operators lacking enterprise compliance infrastructure
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Battery test labs, component distributors, conformity consultants, ERP integrators, and storage installers refer obligated operators
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Permissioned supplier evidence exchange, validation workflow, passport publishing, and audit trail sold as SaaS plus onboarding
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Responsible economic operator pays at supplier onboarding, product-model setup, passport issuance, and recurring evidence maintenance
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A covered battery model or batch must be launched, updated, audited, repaired, transferred, or repurposed

founder_fit: Strong fit with data lineage, AI document processing, renewable context, and EU regulation. A narrow importer or stationary-storage wedge is compatible with part-time work; legal interpretation, conformity assessment, and security review must be bought from specialists.
risks: A passport omission or stale record may create compliance and product-liability exposure.
Long enterprise sales cycles could conflict with part-time execution.
Trade-secret handling and access control demand mature security before sensitive onboarding.

structure.commercial_archetype: Regulated supplier-data network and compliance SaaS
structure.control_point: The reusable, permissioned evidence record feeding the legally responsible battery passport
structure.critical_dependency: Supplier participation and legally adequate data provenance under evolving implementation standards

thesis: Create a permissioned supplier-evidence network for Central European battery assemblers and importers: request component data once, validate provenance, map it into each required passport field, and preserve audit-ready changes. The control point is the reusable evidence graph across supplier, component, model, batch, and responsible economic operator, not a commodity QR-page generator.
title: Battery Passport Supplier Evidence Network
uncertainties: The exact first niche with urgent budget: stationary packs, light mobility, EV imports, or second-life batteries.
Final standards, delegated acts, and customer interpretation of implementation responsibility.
Supplier willingness to share composition and test data with a young intermediary.
